description: Return the Pabandi Platform discovery doc: every tool on the platform, the OpenAPI/spec URL, the PTP verification endpoint, the public key, and the SDK access info. This is the entry point any third-party app, LLM, or agent uses to learn what Pabandi can do and how to call it. This MCP tool makes a real HTTP call to the canonical Pabandi endpoint and returns the actual platform response.
name: pabandi_platform_discovery
